name: What are the common types of ADUs and which one is right for my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of ADUs and which one is right for my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common ADU types include detached (freestanding in the backyard), attached (an addition to the existing home), and converted (e.g., garage conversion, basement conversion). The best type for your property depends on lot size, local zoning regulations, existing structures, and your specific needs. A detached ADU offers more privacy, while a garage conversion can be more cost-effective.
